art_direction: 30岁原创女主穿酒红长大衣，扶着小行李箱在站台等车。
composition_variation: Paint an original 30-year-old anime woman with shoulder-length ash-brown waves, waiting calmly on an empty open-air train platform. She wears an opaque burgundy long coat, cream high-neck knit, straight black trousers, and ankle boots. One hand rests on a compact suitcase handle while the other adjusts her cuff. Use cinematic gouache, pale gold sky, faded sage architecture, and a poised optimistic expression. Keep railway markings absent. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
